analysis: The trial crashed after consuming 540.894 allocated GPU-seconds. No validation score was returned, so improvement over 0.5325 or the reported 0.5387 reference cannot be assessed. The supplied traceback only shows that train.py exited with status 1; it does not expose the underlying exception. Training progress, checkpoint completion, and verification outcomes are unknown. The training subprocess traceback is needed to identify the cause.
code_summary: One independent ConvRec model per category, with tied item embeddings, item biases, four residual causal convolution blocks at dilations 1/2/4/8, and gated prefix memory. The sole proposed architectural change replaces uniform prefix averaging with normalized exponential pooling using one jointly trained scalar decay initialized to 0.9. Padding preserves memory state and emits zero output. Training retains balanced BCE, 256 sampled negatives, a 2048-token limit, AdamW, and validation-based selection of one checkpoint per category. The exported predictor routes all four categories and strictly loads the learned decay parameter. Code includes causality, padding, decay-gradient, and export-agreement checks, but their completion is unconfirmed.
